Gold Price Drop: On November 21, Prime Minister Narendra Modi thanked people for listening to his appeal and not buying gold– which he claims– led to a drop in gold prices. The Indian Express’ Srirupa Goswami hit the streets of Delhi and spoke to buyers and sellers.
